topicName: What is the purpose of the 'finally' block in exception handling?
content: [{"order":1,"type":"heading","text":"What is the purpose of the 'finally' block in exception handling?"},{"order":2,"type":"paragraph","text":"The 'finally' block in exception handling ensures that a block of code is always executed, regardless of whether an exception is thrown or caught.
